title: Organising a food-bank volunteer shift
author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
article: The coordinator will set aside a short briefing before the food-bank opens on Saturday. New volunteers will learn where to store donated goods and how to look after chilled items. During the first hour, a team leader will hand out labels and assign each person a shelf to check. At the end of the shift, volunteers will record low-stock items so the next team can prepare an order.

title: Reviewing laboratory equipment records
author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
article: A research assistant will carry out a quarterly audit of shared laboratory equipment. The team will account for each device by matching its label with the inventory record. In response to several missing calibration dates, the supervisor has added a reminder field to the maintenance log. The next review will check whether staff have entered the dates consistently and whether any device needs servicing before the study begins.

title: Planning maintenance at a bus station
author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
article: The station manager will carry out maintenance on the north entrance escalator next Tuesday. While the work is underway, the escalator will be out of service and signs will direct passengers to the lifts. Staff will inspect the warning boards before the morning rush and report any blocked route to the duty manager. The notice asks passengers to allow a few extra minutes when changing platforms.
